writing.sample_en:
【参考范文 · 172 词】写作无唯一标准答案，以下为达标示范
With the application of information technology in education, college students can now learn in more diverse and efficient ways. Not long ago, learning was confined to a fixed classroom and a single textbook, but technology has broken these limits and reshaped how we acquire knowledge.
On the one hand, learning has become far more diverse. Through massive open online courses, a student in a small town can now attend lectures delivered by professors at top universities, which was once unthinkable, and digital libraries offer millions of books and papers at the click of a button. On the other hand, learning is remarkably efficient. Thanks to AI-powered tutors, questions that once took days to solve can be answered in seconds, and search engines help us locate exactly the material we need. As a result, we save time and study with greater focus.
In conclusion, information technology has enriched both the variety and the speed of learning. Yet we should use these tools wisely, treating them as aids to independent thinking rather than substitutes for it.

lines.en: M: How's your dissertation going? I'm proofreading my first draft and will submit it to my professor tomorrow.
lines.zh: M: 你的学位论文写得怎么样了？我正在校对初稿，明天准备提交给教授。

lines.en: W: Oh, I haven't even started writing mine yet, so I'm really worried about finishing by the end of next semester.
lines.zh: W: 哦，我连写都还没开始写呢，所以我真的很担心下学期末能不能写完。

lines.en: M: You mean you haven't even begun yours yet? The final draft is due in five months.
lines.zh: M: 你是说你连动笔都还没动？终稿还有五个月就要交了。

lines.en: W: Of course I've started it, but I can't get to the writing yet as I haven't found enough resources to use, so I'm still researching the topic.
lines.zh: W: 我当然已经开始了，但我还没找到足够的资料可用，所以还没法开始写，目前还在研究这个课题。

lines.en: M: Maybe the problem is the way you're doing your research. I started by talking to my professor about where to look for information, and based on that, I found books in the library and a lot of reputable journal articles on the Internet.
lines.zh: M: 也许问题出在你做研究的方式上。我是先找教授聊了聊去哪里查找资料，然后根据建议在图书馆找到了书，还在网上找到了许多权威期刊的文章。

lines.en: W: I've tried all that, but don't have enough to write the dissertation as my department's minimum length is 70 pages. I think the problem is that my topic isn't viable. And honestly, my professor did warn me at the beginning that I might not be able to find enough material. But I was so interested in the topic that I didn't let his advice turn me.
lines.zh: W: 这些我都试过了，但资料还是不够写论文，因为我们系要求的最低篇幅是70页。我觉得问题在于我的选题不可行。说实话，我教授刚开始确实警告过我可能找不到足够的材料，但当时我对这个课题太感兴趣了，所以没听他的劝告。

lines.en: M: Well, I suggest you find a new topic. After all, our professors are here to guide us, so it's best to listen to them.
lines.zh: M: 嗯，我建议你换个新选题。毕竟教授是来指导我们的，最好还是听他们的建议。

lines.en: W: In retrospect, I wish I had listened to him, but I didn't. And now I don't want to give up my topic as I've already invested so much time and energy.
lines.zh: W: 回想起来，我真希望当时听了他的话，但我没听。而且现在我已经投入了这么多时间和精力，不想放弃我的选题。

lines.en: M: If you're committed to your current topic, maybe you could make some adjustments rather than abandon it completely. What is your topic?
lines.zh: M: 如果你坚持用现在的选题，也许你可以做些调整，而不是彻底放弃它。你的课题是什么？

lines.en: W: It's "Depictions of Femininity in Folklore from the South of the Country".
lines.zh: W: 是《国内南方民间传说中对女性形象的刻画》。

lines.en: M: That's pretty narrow. You could find more material if you made the topic broader, maybe by including other kinds of depictions.
lines.zh: M: 那范围确实挺窄的。如果你把选题范围放宽一点，比如把其他类型的刻画也包含进来，应该能找到更多资料。

lines.en: W: Broadening the topic is a great idea, I'll start by including folklore from other regions of the country.
lines.zh: W: 放宽选题范围是个好主意，我就从纳入国内其他地区的民间传说开始吧。

transcripts.head: Questions 5 to 8 are based on the conversation you have just heard.

lines.en: W: Today, on Book Talk, we are lucky enough to host John Robbins and discuss his new book, Why Americans Are Fat and How We Can Lose Weight. John isn't just a respected writer; he's also one of the rare celebrity authors writing about science today.
lines.zh: W: 今天，在《图书访谈》节目中，我们非常荣幸地邀请到约翰·罗宾斯，和我们一起讨论他的新书《为什么美国人肥胖以及我们如何减肥》。约翰不仅是一位受人尊敬的作家，也是如今少数几位撰写科学类书籍的知名作家之一。

lines.en: M: Thanks for having me, Rebecca, but I'm hardly a celebrity.
lines.zh: M: 谢谢你的邀请，丽贝卡，不过我实在算不上什么名人。

lines.en: W: That's very modest of you to say, considering that your four books have sold a total of seven million copies worldwide, and they've been translated into 12 different languages. What makes people so fascinated with your work?
lines.zh: W: 考虑到你的四本书在全球总共售出了七百万册，而且被翻译成了十二种不同的语言，你这么说可真谦虚。是什么让人们对你的作品如此着迷呢？

lines.en: M: Well, people read my books because more than 60% of Americans are overweight, or obese. And other countries are facing similar problems. Basically, we all want to know how to fix things.
lines.zh: M: 嗯，人们读我的书，是因为超过百分之六十的美国人超重或肥胖。其他国家也面临着类似的问题。基本上，我们都想知道该如何解决这些问题。

lines.en: W: We certainly do. I've read your new book, and it's fabulous, especially when it comes to the way you make difficult science easy for laymen to understand. That's no small achievement.
lines.zh: W: 我们当然想知道。我读过你的新书，觉得非常精彩，尤其是你把艰深的科学知识讲得通俗易懂这一点。这可不是一件容易做到的事。

lines.en: M: I'm glad to hear you find my work accessible, because I was worried when I wrote it that discussing the science might make the book more suited for a specialist audience. My last book was written primarily for the medical community. But this time, I want to help ordinary people take control of their weight.
lines.zh: M: 听到你觉得我的作品通俗易懂，我很高兴，因为写这本书时，我担心讨论科学内容会让它更适合专业读者阅读。我的上一本书主要是写给医学界人士看的。但这一次，我想帮助普通人掌控自己的体重。

lines.en: W: And how do you suggest they do that? Can you give us the basics of your advice for people who want to lose weight?
lines.zh: W: 那你建议他们怎么做呢？能不能简单介绍一下你对想减肥的人所提出的建议？

lines.en: M: Briefly, I argue that every person needs to consider their metabolism and eat what suits their body's needs. I don't advocate one single diet. Some people should eat more carbohydrates than others. And different people need different amounts of protein and fat.
lines.zh: M: 简单地说，我认为每个人都需要考虑自己的新陈代谢，吃适合自己身体需要的食物。我不主张所有人都采用同一种饮食方式。有些人应该比其他人摄入更多碳水化合物。而且，不同的人对蛋白质和脂肪的需求量也各不相同。

lines.en: W: But you do have some recommendations for everyone, including eating ten servings of vegetables and three of fruit a day. We'll talk about those recommendations next, but now we need to take a short break for a message from our sponsor.
lines.zh: W: 不过，你确实也给所有人提出了一些建议，包括每天吃十份蔬菜和三份水果。接下来我们会谈谈这些建议，不过现在我们要暂时休息一下，听一段赞助商提供的信息。

lines.en: Stress is often depicted as negative, but research shows that moderate amounts of it can be beneficial for your brain and your body.
lines.zh: 压力通常被描绘成负面的事物，但研究表明，适度的压力有益于大脑和身体。

lines.en: First, the benefits for the brain. Studies have shown that short periods of stress can actually bolster cognitive functioning. Researchers discovered that placing rats in a stressful situation for just a few hours doubled the growth of new brain cells. The rats also did better on a memory test later on. Scientists think the same thing happens in humans. But how does stress improve memory? It's simple. When your brain cells multiply, your memory can improve. Viewed from a biological perspective, this makes sense, because animals that are better at remembering dangerous situations can avoid them in the future. If an animal encounters a predator and escapes, for example, it's important to remember where and when that encounter happened. Experts assert that the same principle applies to humans.
lines.zh: 首先来看压力对大脑的益处。研究表明，短时间的压力实际上能够增强认知功能。研究人员发现，让大鼠处于有压力的环境中仅几个小时，就能使新脑细胞的增长速度提高一倍。之后，这些大鼠在记忆测试中的表现也更好。科学家认为，人类身上也会发生同样的情况。但是，压力是如何改善记忆力的呢？原因很简单。当你的脑细胞增多时，你的记忆力可能会得到改善。从生物学角度来看，这是合理的，因为更善于记住危险情境的动物能够在未来避开这些情境。例如，如果一只动物遇到捕食者并成功逃脱，那么记住这次遭遇发生的地点和时间就十分重要。专家断言，同样的原理也适用于人类。

lines.en: Now, let's turn to how stress benefits the body. This may come as a surprise to laymen. But experts say that stress can keep you from getting sick. Scientists concede that chronic stress can make you more prone to illness. But research shows that short periods of stress can actually provide some protection against getting sick, because it increases your immune functioning. One study shows that rats that experienced brief stress had a surge of immune cell response, which makes the immune system better prepared to fight illness. For humans, there's even evidence that experiencing stress before getting vaccinated could help make vaccines more effective.
lines.zh: 现在，我们来看看压力如何有益于身体。这对普通人来说可能令人意外。但专家表示，压力可以使你不易生病。科学家承认，长期压力会使人更容易患病。但研究表明，短时间的压力实际上能够提供一定的防病保护，因为它会增强免疫功能。一项研究显示，经历短暂压力的大鼠，其免疫细胞反应会激增，从而使免疫系统更好地准备对抗疾病。对于人类，甚至有证据表明，在接种疫苗前经历压力可能有助于提高疫苗的有效性。

lines.en: For many managers and people who work in leadership positions, dealing with emails is a dilemma. It's likely the "unpredictable, uncontrollable and ongoing nature of day-to-day email in terms of volume, importance and urgency" contributes to their levels of anxiety and to diminished leadership skills.
lines.zh: 对于许多管理者和担任领导职务的人来说，处理电子邮件是一个两难困境。日常电子邮件在数量、重要性和紧迫性方面“不可预测、不可控制且持续不断”的特性，很可能会加剧他们的焦虑程度并削弱其领导能力。

lines.en: That's because it's not unusual for many leaders to prioritize email management over people management. An obsession with managing their inbox prevents them from dealing with their employees. As a result, they ignore the issues that might only be mild problems at first, until unfortunately, they inevitably transform into a major problem or crisis by virtue of neglect.
lines.zh: 这是因为许多领导者将电子邮件管理置于人员管理之上并不罕见。对管理收件箱的痴迷使他们无法顾及员工。结果，他们忽视了最初可能只是轻微的问题，直到不幸的是，由于疏忽，这些问题不可避免地演变成了重大问题或危机。

lines.en: As leaders, they are expected to motivate and inspire their team in pursuit of longer-term strategic goals and also, less ambitiously but more practically, to monitor their daily output, to set clear expectations and to give regular feedback.
lines.zh: 作为领导者，人们期望他们能够激励和鼓舞团队去追求更长期的战略目标；同时，虽然抱负没那么远大但更为实际的是，监督团队的日常工作产出、设定明确的期望并提供定期反馈。

lines.en: When presented with a choice between the appeal of their inbox and other more important activities, many sacrifice the latter. Daily email demands have a negative impact on their goal progress. This is because leaders must divert resources from other tasks to check, filter and respond to emails.
lines.zh: 当面临收件箱的吸引力与其他更为重要的活动之间的选择时，许多人牺牲了后者。日常电子邮件需求对他们的目标推进产生了负面影响。这是因为领导者必须从其他任务中抽调资源来检查、过滤和回复电子邮件。

lines.en: The solution is cultivating self-control which is like a muscle—it can be strengthened or improved over time through exercise. Some suggestions include making space in your diary for the only periods during which you'll be checking emails, setting a timer for yourself so you don't become distracted by your inbox for too long, turning off email alerts so you're not interrupted by them.
lines.zh: 解决方案是培养自控力，自控力就像肌肉一样——随着时间的推移，可以通过锻炼得到加强或改善。一些建议包括：在日程表中预留出专门用于检查电子邮件的时间段；给自己设置定时器，以免长时间被收件箱分散注意力；关闭电子邮件提醒，以免被其打扰。

lines.en: In last week's lecture, we talked about the problems caused by poor eating habits, focusing on how medical professionals are trying to solve these problems. Today, we'll continue with the topic, but focus on research from a different field—marketing.
lines.zh: 在上周的讲座中，我们讨论了不良饮食习惯所造成的问题，重点关注医疗专业人员如何努力解决这些问题。今天，我们将继续这一主题，但把重点放在另一个领域的研究上——市场营销。

lines.en: Now, what can marketing tell us about improving nutrition? Well, a team of marketing professors has studied the importance of the visual aspect of food and how that influences food choices.
lines.zh: 那么，关于改善营养状况，市场营销能告诉我们什么呢？一组市场营销学教授研究了食物视觉形象的重要性，以及这种视觉形象如何影响人们对食物的选择。

lines.en: Those marketing experts assert that the impact of the appearance of food is greater than we might presume, and might hold the key to encouraging better eating. So how important is the appearance of food?
lines.zh: 这些市场营销专家断言，食物外观的影响比我们可能设想的更大，而且可能是鼓励人们改善饮食的关键。那么，食物的外观究竟有多重要呢？

lines.en: Research shows that just seeing an appealing photograph of a hamburger in an advertisement, for example, can cause individuals to imagine the taste or smell of that hamburger. This can make them more likely to purchase and consume it. Of course, that's the point of advertisements. So isn't that a good thing?
lines.zh: 研究表明，例如，仅仅看到广告中一张诱人的汉堡包照片，就可能使人们联想到汉堡包的味道或气味。这会让他们更有可能购买并食用它。当然，这正是广告的目的。那么，这难道不是一件好事吗？

lines.en: Well, the marketing professors argue that this is actually a problem, because the combination of pleasing aesthetics of and easy access to unhealthy foods, such as hamburgers and pizza, may be contributing to a worldwide health crisis. In fact, statistics show that 39% of all adults in the world weigh too much and another 13% are obese.
lines.zh: 市场营销学教授们认为，实际上这恰恰是一个问题，因为汉堡包和披萨等不健康食品令人愉悦的外观与其易于获得相结合，可能正在助长一场全球性的健康危机。事实上，统计数据显示，全世界有39%的成年人超重，另有13%的人肥胖。

lines.en: Now, as we discussed last time, medical professionals have tried to fight the obesity epidemic by focusing on the nutrients found in different foods, emphasizing things like carbohydrate, fat, sugar and calorie content. But they've had limited success.
lines.zh: 正如我们上次讨论的那样，医疗专业人员曾试图通过关注不同食物所含的营养成分来应对肥胖症流行，强调碳水化合物、脂肪、糖和卡路里含量等因素。但他们取得的成效有限。

lines.en: The marketing professors believe that the real solution to obesity is making food look appealing and focusing on the pleasure of both looking at and eating that food. That pleasure can be used as a tool to promote healthy food choices. In fact, the research done by the team showed that associating healthy food with pleasant images, experiences and emotions led to greater interest in purchasing or eating it. "This is a better strategy," they claim, than reminding consumers that a certain food is good for them. But are they right?
lines.zh: 市场营销学教授们认为，解决肥胖问题的真正办法，是让食物看起来更有吸引力，并关注人们观看和食用这些食物时所获得的愉悦感。这种愉悦感可以被用作促进健康食品选择的工具。事实上，该团队开展的研究表明，将健康食品与令人愉悦的图像、体验和情感联系起来，会使人们对购买或食用这种食品产生更大的兴趣。他们声称，与提醒消费者某种食物对身体有益相比，“这是一种更好的策略”。但他们说得对吗？

lines.en: Well, the researchers cited a marketing campaign designed to reverse the sales decline of carrots. The campaign didn't emphasize the carrots' healthy qualities, but embraced their beauty and the pleasure derived from eating them. For example, the ads focused on the bright, beautiful orange color and crisp texture of the carrots. The campaign led to an impressive increase in product sales of more than 10%. The researchers believe that other companies could bolster sales of healthy foods with similar ads, depicting their products as attractive and a source of pleasure.
lines.zh: 研究人员举例介绍了一项旨在扭转胡萝卜销量下滑的市场营销活动。该活动没有强调胡萝卜的健康特性，而是展现了它们的美感以及食用它们所带来的愉悦感。例如，广告重点突出胡萝卜明亮美丽的橙色和爽脆的口感。这项活动使产品销量大幅增加了10%以上。研究人员认为，其他公司也可以通过类似的广告来促进健康食品的销售，将其产品描绘成具有吸引力且能带来愉悦的食品。

lines.en: The household cleaning products industry really began to take off in the 1950s. Prior to that, resourceful housewives who had grown up in a less prosperous era relied on substances that they used in their kitchens such as vinegar used to clean windows.
lines.zh: 家居清洁用品行业真正开始蓬勃发展是在20世纪50年代。在此之前，那些成长于经济不太繁荣时代、富有创造力的家庭主妇，依靠厨房里使用的物质，例如用醋清洁窗户。

lines.en: Today, the household cleaning products industry is worth billions of dollars a year and is dominated by large global companies. In recent years, however, many countries have witnessed a surge in the number of small businesses and companies offering more environment-friendly cleaning products, and they're doing good business too.
lines.zh: 如今，家居清洁用品行业每年的产值达数十亿美元，并由大型跨国公司主导。然而，近年来，许多国家都见证了提供更环保清洁产品的小型企业和公司的数量激增，而且它们的生意也做得很好。

lines.en: One reason for this is that consumers are becoming more aware of environment and sustainability issues. They also want to make their home a safe place, free from toxic chemicals. The third reason is people's awareness of and knowledge about technology has never been greater. In the past, people might have been skeptical of a new product claimed to be able to achieve amazing cleaning results, but they now have faith in technology's ability to do what was once thought impossible.
lines.zh: 其中一个原因是消费者越来越意识到环境和可持续性问题。他们还希望把家变成一个没有有毒化学物质的安全场所。第三个原因是，人们对技术的认识和了解从未像现在这样深入。过去，人们可能会对一种声称能够取得惊人清洁效果的新产品持怀疑态度，但如今，他们相信技术有能力做到那些曾经被认为不可能的事情。

lines.en: There is perhaps no better example of this than a patented cloth sold by one company, which remarkably uses only water rather than traditional cleaning products. The company claims its cloth lifts, traps and removes dirt and bacteria. And considering that people don't see these products in shops, or advertised on TV or in the press, it has been a pretty steep rise.
lines.zh: 或许没有什么比某家公司销售的一种获得专利的抹布更能说明这一点了。这种抹布非常特别，只使用水，而不是传统的清洁产品。该公司声称，这种抹布能够提起、吸附并清除污垢和细菌。考虑到人们既不会在商店里看到这些产品，也不会在电视、报刊或杂志上看到它们的广告，它们的增长速度着实非常快。

lines.en: Many of the people behind these companies began testing the viability of their products by selling them at local markets. Then, in many cases, customers are doing the marketing for these products by leaving threads of comments on social media, praising their virtues. There are also TV shows and books dedicated to maintaining home tidiness and cleanliness and the benefits of having a clean home.
lines.zh: 这些公司背后的许多人都是通过在当地市场销售产品，开始测试产品是否具有可行性的。随后，在许多情况下，顾客通过在社交媒体上留下大量评论、称赞这些产品的优点，为它们进行营销。此外，还有专门介绍保持家庭整洁、清洁以及拥有一个干净家庭的益处的电视节目和书籍。

lines.en: Having a safe and clean home might be one thing people feel they can control in an increasingly out-of-control world. And there are social media celebrities. One woman in Britain has become a social media sensation with more than two million followers for her cleaning tips page.
lines.zh: 在一个越来越失控的世界里，拥有一个安全而干净的家，可能是人们觉得自己能够掌控的一件事。而且，还有社交媒体名人。英国有一名女性凭借她的清洁技巧页面成为社交媒体红人，粉丝数量超过两百万。

lines.en: Throwing spare change into a fountain is a time-honored ritual: throw a penny into the water, and your wish might come true. But all that money has to go somewhere. Otherwise, the growing piles of pennies, quarters and euros could clog up the fountains' works. Today, I'm going to talk about where all the coins go.
lines.zh: 把多余的零钱扔进喷泉是一种历史悠久的仪式：把一枚硬币扔进水里，你的愿望就可能实现。但所有这些钱都必须有去处。否则，越积越多的便士、25美分硬币和欧元硬币可能会堵塞喷泉的内部装置。今天，我要讲讲这些硬币最终都去了哪里。

lines.en: Well, the coins collected can go to all sorts of different places—from fountain maintenance to charity or public service. In New York City, for example, coins collected from fountains in public parks often go towards the fountains' maintenance itself, though entrepreneurs who don't mind getting their hands wet often get to it first. There are over 50 beautiful decorative display fountains in New York City parks. They are cleaned by the parks' staff every few weeks. But most of the coins have already been removed by entrepreneurial New Yorkers and there is not a significant amount left to be collected.
lines.zh: 收集到的硬币可以被用于各种不同的地方，例如喷泉维护、慈善事业或公共服务。以纽约市为例，从公共公园喷泉中收集的硬币通常会用于喷泉本身的维护，不过那些不介意把手弄湿的投机者往往会先下手。纽约市的公园里有50多座漂亮的装饰性展示喷泉。公园工作人员每隔几周会对它们进行清洁。但大多数硬币早已被纽约的投机者取走，剩下可收集的数量并不多。

lines.en: Other cities, though, can pull in a much more serious haul. Take for example, Rome's famous Trevi fountain: for hundreds of years, visitors have thrown coins over their shoulder into the fountain to ensure that they will return. So many tourists toss in coins that Roman officials have the fountain cleaned every night, reportedly getting as much as $4,000 in loose change from around the world each day. Most of the money collected each night goes towards running a supermarket for the needy. And collecting that cash is serious business. Roman officials have been known to be tough on anyone caught skimming coins from the fountain. In one case in 2005, police arrested four fountain cleaners after they were spotted slipping coins into their own pockets after collecting them. Authorities finally caught one notorious thief named Thomas Morgan and banned him from the fountain after he fished out thousands of dollars in change over 34 years using a magnetic stick.
lines.zh: 不过，其他城市的喷泉可能会带来多得多的收入。以罗马著名的特莱维喷泉为例：数百年来，游客一直将硬币从肩后抛入喷泉，以确保自己将来还会回来。如此多的游客往里投硬币，以至于罗马官员每天晚上都会安排清理喷泉，据报道，每天能从中获得多达4,000美元的世界各地零钱。每晚收集到的大部分钱都用于运营一家为贫困者服务的超市。而收集这些现金是一项严肃的工作。众所周知，罗马官员会严厉对待任何被发现从喷泉中偷取硬币的人。2005年就发生过一起案件：警方发现四名喷泉清洁工在收集硬币后把硬币偷偷塞进自己的口袋，随后将他们逮捕。最终，当局抓住了一名臭名昭著的小偷Thomas Morgan，并禁止他进入喷泉区域；在34年间，他曾用一根磁力棒从喷泉中捞出数千美元的零钱。

lines.en: For the most part, money collected from privately-owned fountains in the United States also goes to charity. The fountain in New York City's Bryant Park is owned and operated by a not-for-profit corporation, which puts the cash collected by cleaners towards the fountain's own maintenance. Tens of thousands of dollars in coins removed from wishing wells, fountains and ponds in Florida's Walt Disney World are donated each year to support foster children living in the state. Whether or not your wish comes true after tossing a coin into a fountain, you can rest assured knowing that the change is likely going to someone who needs it.
lines.zh: 在美国，从私人拥有的喷泉中收集到的钱大多也会捐给慈善机构。纽约市布莱恩特公园的喷泉由一家非营利公司所有并运营，清洁工收集到的现金会被用于喷泉本身的维护。佛罗里达州华特迪士尼世界的许愿井、喷泉和池塘中每年取出的数万美元硬币，都会被捐出，用于帮助生活在该州的寄养儿童。无论你把硬币扔进喷泉后愿望是否实现，你都可以放心，因为这些零钱很可能会流向需要帮助的人。

analysis.信号: discovered 后接发现内容。答案句由 Researchers discovered that 引出，研究动词 discovered 后面紧跟的就是题干要的发现，是天然的答案信号；同时 doubled the growth of new brain cells 给出明确的量化结果，更确认这就是落点。

My class went on; we talked about poems. But despite the fact that the rest of our days on campus passed __(29)__ , I was rattled. I couldn't shake the sense that in this country we always live at __(30)__ risk.
passages.zh: 我吓得头晕目眩。后来 выяс明，这名女子是一名无法获得药物的精神分裂症患者。经过一番强行制止，她被带离现场并护送离开，随后被送进医院接受观察；相比我们中的任何一个人提出指控，这一步实际上对所有人都更安全。我的课继续进行，我们谈论着诗歌。但尽管此后我们在校园里的日子平静度过，我仍然心神不宁。我无法摆脱这样一种感觉：在这个国家，我们始终生活在令人难以置信的风险之中。

passages.en: A few months later, crisis __(31)__ again. While my husband was locking his bike to drop off our 3-year-old daughter for her preschool-aged day camp, a different woman approached. Swiftly and for no __(32)__ reason, she bent down, picked up our daughter, and began to carry her down the street. It was so fast and confusing that my daughter __(33)__ cried. My husband, in a burst of speed, chased the woman and reclaimed our daughter. The woman, clearly confused, retreated into the public library. A __(34)__ of homeless people who generally know the other homeless in the area said they did not recognize the woman. The woman was so clearly unwell that when she was taken into custody she was incoherent. Heartbreakingly, she called our daughter by the name of someone else's child. Each part of the episode was as haunting as it was __(35)__ .
passages.zh: 几个月后，危机再次降临。当我丈夫把自行车锁好，准备送我们三岁的女儿去参加面向学龄前儿童的日间营时，另一名女子走了过来。她迅速地、毫无明显原因地弯下腰，抱起我们的女儿，开始沿街把她带走。事情发生得如此之快，如此令人困惑，以至于我的女儿几乎没有哭出来。我的丈夫突然加速追上那名女子，夺回了我们的女儿。那名女子显然神志不清，退进了公共图书馆。一群通常认识这一带其他无家可归者的无家可归者表示，他们不认识这名女子。她显然病得很重，被拘押时语无伦次。令人心碎的是，她把我们的女儿叫成了另一个孩子的名字。这一事件的每一个环节都既令人难以忘怀，又令人恐惧。

wordbank.gloss: （名）使用权、获取途径；（动）进入、访问
（动词过去式/过去分词）护送、押送
（freeze 的过去式）僵住、呆住、冻结
（名）网络、人脉群体；（动）建立联系
（动词过去式/过去分词）压抑、抑制；（形）被压抑的
（strike 的过去式/过去分词）袭击、突然发生、给…以打击

rows.text: F) froze动词
主语 We all 后缺谓语动词，需一般过去时
听到『我有三把枪』后所有人本能呆住 上文 I have three guns and I want to use them. 是极端威胁，紧接 We all 的反应只能是吓得僵住——freeze 正是英语里表达『因恐惧而瞬间不动』的高频动词，与下文 I was dizzy with fear. 形成连贯的恐惧反应链。

E)escorted及物动词，缺宾语 escort 意为『护送某人』，必须带宾语，而句子是 We all __(26)__. 后面直接句号，无宾语；且『我们护送了』也对不上听到威胁后的第一反应。 M)stifled及物且语义不符 stifle 通常作及物动词（压抑哭声/笑声），后面缺宾语；语义上『我们都压抑了』也无对象，语境不通。 N)struck强搭配指向第 31 题 strike 在此语境里更常以 crisis struck（危机突然发生）这一固定搭配出现，后文 crisis __(31)__ again 才是它的归宿；用在 26 空只能解作『打击/击中』，缺宾语也不成句。
A) access名词
介词 without 后接名词
access to 是固定搭配，意为『使用权』 have/without access to + 物 是英语里表达『（无法）获得/使用某物』的标准搭配。原句 without access to her medications 即『无法获得自己的药物』，与精神分裂症患者发病的语境完全契合：因为没药才会发作、闯进课堂。

D)dedication语义荒诞 dedication 指『奉献、专注』，dedication to her medications 字面是『对药物的奉献』，对精神患者而言荒诞；语义与上下文医疗背景脱节。 I)network搭配指向第 34 题 network of people / network of homeless 是更经典的搭配，将在第 34 空发挥作用；用在 27 空 network to her medications 不成习语，搭配生硬。
E) escorted动词
并列连词 and 后接同形态过去分词
escorted away 表『被护送/押送离开』 escort 常与 in/out/away 搭配，表示有专人带某人离开。原文 wrestled out and escorted away, then put in a hospital for observation，先是被拽出去、再被护送走、然后送医观察——动作链条流畅自然。
M)stifled搭配与语义都不对 stifled away 不是英语固定搭配；stifle 表『压抑哭声/欲望』，与『从课堂带走精神患者』这一物理动作毫不相干。
K) peacefully副词
修饰动词 passed，需副词

与『despite + I was rattled』形成让步对比 原句 despite the fact that the rest of our days on campus passed __(29)__, I was rattled. 用 despite 引出让步：表面上的日子平静，与内心仍受惊形成反差。peacefully（平静地）正好与 rattled（心神不宁）构成『外平静、内不安』的对照。
C)barely语义反向，破坏让步逻辑 barely 意为『几乎不』，『日子几乎没过去』不成话；且与 despite 之后『虽然…平稳，但我仍受惊』的逻辑反向。 L)presumably推测语气与亲历叙述冲突 presumably 表『大概、想必』，用于推测；作者亲身在校园，对自己后续的日子是亲历不是推测，语气不匹配。
G) incredible形容词
介词 at 与名词 risk 之间需形容词
at incredible risk 强调难以置信的高风险 incredible 在这里取『大到难以置信』的语义。前文叙述了课堂枪击威胁，作者由此得出 we always live at __(30)__ risk 的结论——『生活在难以置信的高风险里』，与全文的极端恐惧场景吻合，且与下段又一桩街头事件互证。
H)indignant对象错配 indignant 修饰人或情绪，an indignant risk 不成习惯搭配，语法上虽通但语义荒诞。 J)overriding色彩偏向中性『首要』 overriding risk 偏向 commercial/legal 等正式语体里『首要风险』，多用于风险评估；与本句日常生活的弥散性恐惧的语感不符，更不如 incredible 突出『程度令人震惊』。

最具迷惑性的错误词是 J) —— overriding risk 像高级搭配但语体错位。考生背过 overriding priority/concern 这类搭配，会自然延伸出 overriding risk，且词性也对、句法也通。防坑：本文是抒情散文，谈的是『日常生活里弥散的恐惧』，需要程度词（incredible），不是商务正式语体里的『首要风险』。判断不准时回到全文情绪基调——能与 I was dizzy with fear. 共振的，才是答案。
N) struck动词
主语 crisis 后缺谓语动词

crisis struck again 是地道高频搭配 strike 作不及物动词时常表示『（灾难/危机/事故）突然降临』，crisis/disaster/tragedy struck 是固定句式。本段开头 A few months later, crisis __(31)__ again. 正是用这一句承接上一段课堂事件，引出新的危机——结构上与 Each part of the episode was as haunting as it was __(35)__. 所暗示的反复灾祸呼应。
E)escorted及物且语义反向 escort 必须带人作宾语；且 crisis escorted 字面是『危机护送』，毫无意义。 M)stifled主语错位 stifle 是『压抑、扼制』，主语通常是人或机构（压抑某种东西），crisis stifled 反过来了，且 stifle 也需要宾语，本句缺。
B) apparent形容词
no 与名词 reason 之间需形容词修饰
for no apparent reason 是固定搭配 for no apparent reason 意为『没有明显的理由』，是英语里描述行为突兀、动机不明的常用表达。陌生女子毫无来由抱走孩子，正符合此意——上文 Swiftly and for no __(32)__ reason 用 Swiftly 强调动作之突兀，apparent 与之呼应。

H)indignant感情色彩错位 indignant 形容『义愤填膺的』，用于描述人或情绪，而非 reason；an indignant reason 不成搭配，逻辑上女子也并非出于义愤。 J)overriding搭配相反 overriding reason 意为『压倒一切的理由』，是『有强烈理由』；与本句 no（没有）连用语义自相矛盾——无『压倒一切』的理由是把强调有理由的词放到了否定语境，明显别扭。
C) barely副词
主谓之间修饰动词 cried
事情发生太快太懵，孩子几乎没来得及哭 上文 It was so fast and confusing 已经为此空铺垫——动作迅猛、孩子来不及反应。barely cried 即『几乎没哭出声』，与『fast and confusing』因果连贯：还没反应过来，父亲就追上抢回了孩子。
L)presumably推测语气与亲历叙述冲突 presumably 表『大概』，是写作者对未亲见之事的推测；但作者一家亲历整段，包括孩子的反应，无须推测，语气错位。
最具迷惑性的错误词是 L) —— presumably 看似谨慎但叙述视角不对。副词组只剩 C/L 两个，presumably cried 也能勉强解为『大概哭了』，似乎留有余地；但本段是作者一家亲历，连孩子叫了别人孩子的名字这种细节都记得，没必要用『大概』。防坑：副词二选一时回看叙述视角——亲历用具体程度词（barely），未亲见才用推测词（presumably）。
I) network名词
冠词 A 与 of 短语之间的主语位置
a network of homeless people 表『流浪者之间的人际网』 network of + 人群 指『某群体的人际网络』，与定语从句 who generally know the other homeless in the area 完美呼应——彼此互相认识的群体正是『一张网』。
D)dedication搭配与单复数都不对 dedication of homeless people 不构成英语习惯搭配；且 dedication 表抽象品质，与定语从句『相互认识』的群体属性无关。
O) terrifying形容词
as…as 比较结构后接形容词

与 haunting 同色调、共同收束恐怖基调 haunting 意为『萦绕心头、挥之不去的（恐惧）』，与 terrifying（令人恐惧的）感情色彩一致——孩子被陌生人抱走这一段经历，既挥之不去又骇人。这个收尾与第二段 I couldn't shake the sense that in this country we always live at __(30)__ risk. 的恐惧基调一脉相承，是全文情感的回扣。

G)incredible词义模糊，色彩不齐 incredible 表『难以置信』，可褒可贬；与 haunting 的负面色调虽不冲突但不够对位，而 incredible 已在 30 题作为更精准的『难以估量的风险』所需。 H)indignant对象错配 indignant 是『义愤的』，形容人或情绪，不修饰 episode（事件）。 J)overriding语义不搭 overriding 是『压倒一切的、最重要的』，an overriding episode 不成英语；与 haunting 也不构成同色调对应。

longreading.title: 2022年12月·第1套 英语六级长篇阅读（信息匹配） 第 1 篇 · 36–45 题答案与解析

passages.en: A) Michael Wardian pushed forward into the penetrating arctic(北极的) wind, fighting the urge to speed up. Too much effort and he'd begin to sweat, which, he was told, would only increase the risk of hypothermia(体温过低).
passages.zh: 迈克尔·沃迪安顶着刺骨的北极寒风向前迈进，努力克制着加速的冲动。有人告诉他，过度用力会开始出汗，而这只会增加体温过低的风险。

passages.en: B) At the 2014 North Pole Marathon, the temperature dipped to minus-22 degrees F, with a wind chill that made it feel even colder. Along the route, armed guards wandered the large sheets of floating ice to minimize the risk of polar bear attacks.
passages.zh: 在2014年北极马拉松比赛中，气温降至零下22华氏度，风寒效应使人感觉更加寒冷。沿途，持枪警卫在大片浮冰上来回巡逻，以尽量降低遭到北极熊袭击的风险。

passages.en: C) "I like to do stuff that scares me," Wardian said. With ice frozen to his beard, Wardian crossed the finish line that April afternoon in a winning time of 4 hours 7 minutes and 40 seconds, almost two hours slower than his personal best over 26.2 miles. The race for Wardian, however, was less about the result than overcoming his aversion to the cold.
passages.zh: “我喜欢做让自己感到害怕的事情。”沃迪安说。胡须上结着冰的沃迪安在那个四月的午后以4小时7分40秒的成绩冲过终点线，虽然获胜，但比他在26.2英里赛程中的个人最好成绩慢了将近两个小时。然而，对沃迪安而言，这场比赛与其说是为了成绩，不如说是为了克服自己对寒冷的厌恶。

passages.en: D) In a few days, Wardian will once again compete in an unfamiliar territory and below-freezing temperatures. He will line up Monday in Antarctica(南极) for the first leg of the World Marathon Challenge—joining 32 other adventure seekers on an unusual journey where participants travel through different time zones and climates to run seven marathons on seven continents in seven days.
passages.zh: 几天后，沃迪安将再次在陌生的地域和零度以下的气温中参赛。周一，他将在南极排队参加世界马拉松挑战赛的第一站，与另外32名冒险者一同踏上这段不同寻常的旅程。参赛者将穿越不同的时区和气候，在七天内于七大洲各跑一场马拉松。

passages.en: E) An elite ultra-runner, Wardian has his sights on breaking the event's record average marathon time of 3:32:25 set last January by U.S. Marine Corps captain Daniel Cartica. Wardian, a 42-year-old Arlington resident, is a record-breaking racer, known in the ultra-running community for seeking tough courses and setting world records. Last year, he ran 1,254.65 miles in 47 races. The World Marathon Challenge, like most of Wardian's running goals, will be about pushing his limits. "I love diverse and unique challenges," he said. "I'm definitely interested in seeing what I can handle and what my body can accept. That drives me."
passages.zh: 作为一名顶尖超长距离跑者，沃迪安的目标是打破该赛事去年一月由美国海军陆战队上尉丹尼尔·卡蒂卡创造的平均马拉松用时3小时32分25秒的纪录。42岁的沃迪安是阿灵顿居民，也是一名屡破纪录的赛跑者；在超长距离跑圈内，他因专挑艰难赛道并创造世界纪录而闻名。去年，他参加了47场比赛，共跑了1254.65英里。与沃迪安的大多数跑步目标一样，世界马拉松挑战赛也将是一次突破极限的经历。“我喜欢多样而独特的挑战。”他说，“我确实很想看看自己能够承受什么，以及我的身体能够接受什么。这就是驱动我的力量。”

passages.en: F) Something about the way Richard Donovan carried himself appealed to Wardian. Perhaps it was the sense of adventure Donovan displayed when they first met at the 2010 50K Championships in Galway, Ireland, where Donovan was the race director. The two hit it off, and soon Wardian was participating in Donovan's events. It was at the North Pole Marathon, a race that Donovan organizes, that Wardian first heard about the Irishman's plan for the World Marathon Challenge—a challenge that Donovan himself completed in 2009 and 2012. "I knew that many people had a goal of running seven marathons on seven continents during any time period," Donovan, 50, said. "I felt the natural extension to this idea would be to try to achieve it within a seven-day period."
passages.zh: 理查德·多诺万待人处世的方式有些地方吸引了沃迪安。也许是因为他们第一次见面时，多诺万表现出的冒险精神。那是在2010年爱尔兰戈尔韦举行的50公里锦标赛上，多诺万担任赛事总监。两人一见如故，不久后沃迪安便开始参加多诺万组织的赛事。正是在由多诺万组织的北极马拉松比赛中，沃迪安第一次听说这位爱尔兰人筹办世界马拉松挑战赛的计划，而多诺万本人曾于2009年和2012年完成过这一挑战。“我知道，很多人的目标是在任何一段时间内于七大洲各跑一场马拉松。”50岁的多诺万说，“我觉得这一想法自然可以延伸为，尝试在七天之内完成这件事。”

passages.en: G) Wardian started saving for the trip in 2014, connecting with sponsors and getting approval from his wife, Jennifer, before committing. Registration for the event costs 36,000 euros, which covers international charter flights to each of the seven marathon locations: Union Glacier (Antarctica), Punta Arenas, Chile (South America), Miami (North America), Madrid (Europe), Marrakesh, Morocco (Africa), Dubai (Asia) and Sydney (Australia). The challenge is a test of both physical strength and mental fitness. Sleeping on a crammed plane, adjusting to different time zones and finding food to eat (Wardian is a vegetarian) would make it an exhausting trip over a month, let alone a week. "The key to a race like this is getting comfortable being uncomfortable," said Becca Pizzi, last year's women's champion. "The highs of the race are incredibly high, and the lows incredibly low."
passages.zh: 沃迪安从2014年开始为这次旅行攒钱，联系赞助商，并在得到妻子詹妮弗的同意后才作出决定。赛事报名费为3.6万欧元，其中包括前往七个马拉松举办地的国际包机费用：联合冰川（南极洲）、智利蓬塔阿雷纳斯（南美洲）、迈阿密（北美洲）、马德里（欧洲）、摩洛哥马拉喀什（非洲）、迪拜（亚洲）和悉尼（澳大利亚）。这项挑战考验的不仅是体力，也是心理素质。在拥挤的飞机上睡觉、适应不同的时区以及寻找食物（沃迪安是素食者），即使花上一个月也会令人疲惫不堪，更不用说要在一周内完成。“参加这种比赛的关键，是学会适应不舒适的状态。”去年的女子冠军贝卡·皮齐说，“比赛中的高潮极其令人振奋，低谷也极其令人难受。”

passages.en: H) Since turning it into an organized event in 2015, Donovan has attracted a variety of runners. This year's challenge will feature a far more elite field, which includes Ryan Hall, America's fastest marathon runner. Despite his proven track record, Hall said he has no time goals and that he still suffers from the same fatigue issues that forced him to leave the professional ranks in 2015. Hall plans to run with his friend, Pastor Matthew Barnett of The Dream Center in Los Angeles—one of the six American men who will be competing. "I don't expect to run a step with Mike, but I will be excited to see how he does," said the 34-year-old Hall, who began weight-lifting after retiring. "If I finish within an hour of him in each marathon, I'd be surprised."
passages.zh: 自2015年将其发展为一项有组织的赛事以来，多诺万吸引了各种各样的跑者。今年的挑战赛将拥有实力强得多的参赛阵容，其中包括美国跑得最快的马拉松运动员瑞安·霍尔。尽管战绩有目共睹，霍尔表示自己没有具体的时间目标，而且仍然受到同样的疲劳问题困扰，正是这个问题迫使他在2015年离开职业赛场。霍尔计划与好友、洛杉矶梦想中心的马修·巴内特牧师一起参赛；巴内特是将参加比赛的六名美国男子之一。“我不指望能和迈克一起跑哪怕一步，但我会很期待看到他的表现。”34岁的霍尔说。他退役后开始进行举重训练。“如果我在每场马拉松中都能在他一小时之内完赛，我都会感到惊讶。”

passages.en: I) Instead, 43-year-old Petr Vabrousek, an elite Czech Ironman champion, is expected to be Wardian's closest challenger. To others on the trip, simply finishing will be its own reward. Sinead Kane of Ireland is aiming to become the first blind person to complete the challenge. And Beth Ann Telford, a 47-year-old federal government worker from Fairfax and the only American female in this year's mix, is using the event as a platform to raise money for cancer research. It's a cause with a personal connection to Telford, who was diagnosed with brain cancer in 2004. "Doing something like this is definitely the hardest challenge that I've ever done except for the chemotherapy and brain surgery," she said. "It's going to raise awareness. …I just wanted to do something that is epic and this certainly is right up there." Wardian, too, hopes his involvement will give him a platform to promote a cause. He recently became an ambassador for the United Nations Women's HeForShe initiative to fight inequalities faced by women and girls worldwide.
passages.zh: 相反，43岁的捷克顶尖铁人三项冠军佩特尔·瓦布鲁塞克预计将成为沃迪安最接近的竞争者。对这次旅程中的其他人来说，仅仅完成挑战本身就是一种回报。爱尔兰的西妮德·凯恩希望成为首位完成这项挑战的盲人。47岁的贝丝·安·特尔福德来自费尔法克斯，是今年参赛者中唯一的美国女性；她将这项赛事作为筹款平台，为癌症研究募集资金。这一事业与特尔福德有着个人联系，她于2004年被诊断出患有脑癌。“除了化疗和脑部手术，做这样的事情无疑是我经历过的最艰难的挑战。”她说，“这会提高人们的关注度……我只是想做一件史诗般的事情，而这项挑战绝对称得上。”沃迪安也希望自己的参与能为他提供一个推广某项事业的平台。他最近成为联合国妇女署“他为她”倡议的大使，致力于对抗世界各地女性和女孩所面临的不平等。

passages.en: J) On a chilly December afternoon, Wardian wove through Washington's crowded sidewalks on the way home from his full-time job as an international ship broker. His elastic, 6-foot frame bounced gently and efficiently off the ground with each step of the hilly six-mile trip back to Arlington. This is a daily routine during the week for Wardian, who started racing professionally in 2003 and runs seven days a week, often multiple times a day. When he travels, he prefers to explore new places on his feet.
passages.zh: 十二月一个寒冷的午后，沃迪安结束国际船舶经纪人的全职工作回家时，穿行在华盛顿拥挤的人行道上。在返回阿灵顿的六英里上坡路程中，他那副修长而富有弹性的身躯每迈一步都轻盈而高效地弹离地面。对沃迪安来说，这已是工作日里的日常。他从2003年开始参加职业比赛，每周七天都跑步，而且常常一天跑几次。旅行时，他喜欢用双脚探索新的地方。

passages.en: K) But in some ways, Wardian still has trouble thinking of himself as a runner. For the majority of his childhood, Wardian devoted his energy to becoming a Division I lacrosse(长曲棍球) player-a dream he realized when he was recruited to play at Michigan State University. "Once he decides to do something, he just works at it until he does it," Michael's younger sister, Mariele, said. "Once he decides to do it, it's usually something that's going to happen. He's always been like that. He's a very motivated individual."
passages.zh: 但在某些方面，沃迪安仍然很难把自己看作一名跑者。在童年的大部分时间里，沃迪安都把精力投入到成为一名一级长曲棍球运动员的目标上；后来，他如愿被密歇根州立大学招募入队。“一旦他决定做某件事，就会一直努力，直到做到为止。”迈克尔的妹妹玛丽埃尔说，“他一旦决定去做，通常这件事就一定会实现。他一直都是这样。他是一个非常有动力的人。”

passages.en: L) It was only a year or so ago that Wardian realized that he had been a runner longer than a lacrosse player. It was not until he ran in the 2004 U.S. Olympic Marathon Trials-the first of three for Wardian-that he felt that he was a legitimate runner. Now more than 10 years and numerous ultra-marathon national titles and world records later, he embraces that identity. Wardian wants to see how far his legs can take him, one epic challenge at a time. "I want to always keep doing things that are exciting, adventurous, different and most importantly, probably things I'm not the best at," Wardian said, "because if you're not seeking things out that are challenging and difficult for you, then you're not growing … So I hope maybe people see what I do, and say, 'Okay, I want to do something different or try something new. … I'm going to do something that scares me.' That's what I'm hoping people will take from it."
passages.zh: 大约直到一年前，沃迪安才意识到，自己从事跑步的时间已经超过了打长曲棍球的时间。直到参加2004年美国奥运会马拉松选拔赛——那是沃迪安参加的三次选拔赛中的第一次——他才觉得自己是一名真正的跑者。如今，十多年过去了，在赢得众多超马全国冠军并创造多项世界纪录之后，他已经接受了这一身份。沃迪安想知道自己的双腿究竟能带他走多远，一次完成一个史诗般的挑战。“我希望自己始终做一些令人兴奋、充满冒险、与众不同的事情，更重要的是，做一些我可能并不擅长的事情。”沃迪安说，“因为如果你不去寻找那些对自己来说具有挑战性和困难的事情，你就不会成长……所以我希望人们也许能看到我所做的事，然后说：‘好，我想做点不同的事情，或者尝试一些新东西……我要做一件让我害怕的事。’这就是我希望人们从中得到的启发。”

statements.en: Wardian regards the various extraordinary challenges as a test of his physical endurance
statements.zh: Wardian 将各种非凡的挑战视为对其身体耐力的考验

analysis.锚点: 把各种非凡挑战当作身体耐力的测试
analysis.定位: E 段 I love diverse and unique challenges, he said. I'm definitely interested in seeing what I can handle and what my body can accept. That drives me. 「我热爱多样而独特的挑战，」他说，「我非常想看看自己能扛多少、身体能接受到什么程度。这正是驱动我前进的东西。」
analysis.改写: the various extraordinary challenges↔diverse and unique challenges 形容词同义词替换 a test of his physical endurance↔seeing what I can handle and what my body can accept 动词短语被概括为抽象名词（名词化）
analysis.辨邻: L L段的核心是if you're not seeking things out that are challenging and difficult for you, then you're not growing——是「成长论」而非「身体耐力测试论」，话题相邻但命题方向不同。 I want to always keep doing things that are exciting, adventurous, different and most importantly, probably things I'm not the best at K K段焦点在Once he decides to do something, he just works at it until he does it——这是「决心-执行力」的评价，与「身体耐力测试」无关。 Once he decides to do something, he just works at it until he does it

statements.en: Wardian hopes his participation in the seven-day marathon series will contribute to a worthy cause.
statements.zh: Wardian 希望他参加为期七天的马拉松系列赛将有助于一项有价值的事业

analysis.锚点: 希望以七日赛参与为公益事业出力
analysis.定位: I 段 Wardian, too, hopes his involvement will give him a platform to promote a cause. He recently became an ambassador for the United Nations Women's HeForShe initiative to fight inequalities faced by women and girls worldwide. Wardian同样希望，自己的这次参赛能给他一个平台来推动某项事业。他不久前成为联合国HeForShe运动的形象大使，旨在反抗全球女性和女孩面临的不平等。
analysis.改写: his participation in the seven-day marathon series↔his involvement 概括上位（具体到抽象） will contribute to a worthy cause↔will give him a platform to promote a cause 动作同义替换+评价性形容词补足
analysis.辨邻: L L段焦点是I hope maybe people see what I do, and say, Okay, I want to do something different or try something new——是个体激励层面，与陈述句要的「contribute to a worthy cause」（推动公益事业）不在同一命题上。 I hope maybe people see what I do

statements.en: Wardian is going to join over thirty other runners in a week-long marathon series.
statements.zh: Wardian 将与其他三十多名跑者一起参加为期一周的马拉松系列赛

analysis.锚点: 与三十多名跑者一起加入为期一周的马拉松系列赛
analysis.定位: D 段 He will line up Monday in Antarctica for the first leg of the World Marathon Challenge—joining 32 other adventure seekers on an unusual journey where participants travel through different time zones and climates to run seven marathons on seven continents in seven days. 他将于周一在南极站上世界马拉松挑战赛的第一段起点——与另外32位冒险者一同踏上这趟非凡之旅：参赛者们穿越不同时区与气候，在七天里跑完七大洲的七场马拉松。
analysis.改写: over thirty other runners↔32 other adventure seekers 数字落入范围+下位词替换 a week-long marathon series↔seven marathons on seven continents in seven days 时间+赛事被压缩成抽象表述
analysis.辨邻: H H段强调阵容more elite，没说人数；陈述句要的是「数量超过30人」的具体事实，匹配点必须落在D段。 This year's challenge will feature a far more elite field, which includes Ryan Hall, America's fastest marathon runner

statements.en: Over-exertion in extreme cold can lower one's body temperature to a dangerous point.
statements.zh: 在极度寒冷中过度劳累会使人的体温降至危险水平

analysis.锚点: 极寒下用力过猛会把体温降到危险点
analysis.定位: A 段 Too much effort and he'd begin to sweat, which, he was told, would only increase the risk of hypothermia. 用力过猛他就会开始出汗，而别人告诉他，那只会增加体温过低的风险。
analysis.改写: Over-exertion in extreme cold↔Too much effort and he'd begin to sweat 动作描述对应：用力过猛=Over-exertion can lower one's body temperature to a dangerous point↔would only increase the risk of hypothermia 专有术语的白话定义改写
analysis.辨邻: B B段焦点在天气数据和外部风险（北极熊），没有把「过度用力」与「体温下降」挂钩——而陈述句问的正是这条机理。 At the 2014 North Pole Marathon, the temperature dipped to minus-22 degrees F, with a wind chill that made it feel even colder C C段关注的是Wardian通过比赛战胜his aversion to the cold，是心理层面，与陈述句的生理机理（用力—出汗—失温）不在同一维度。 The race for Wardian, however, was less about the result than overcoming his aversion to the cold

statements.en: Wardian was very much impressed by a race director's sense of adventure.
statements.zh: Wardian 对一位赛事总监的冒险精神印象深刻

analysis.锚点: 某位赛事总监的冒险气质打动了Wardian
analysis.定位: F 段 Something about the way Richard Donovan carried himself appealed to Wardian. Perhaps it was the sense of adventure Donovan displayed when they first met at the 2010 50K Championships in Galway, Ireland, where Donovan was the race director. Richard Donovan的某种气质打动了Wardian。也许就是2010年爱尔兰Galway的50K锦标赛上、Donovan作为赛事总监出场时所展现的那种冒险精神。
analysis.改写: was very much impressed by↔Something about the way Richard Donovan carried himself appealed to Wardian 动词同义替换：impressed by≈appealed to a race director's sense of adventure↔the sense of adventure Donovan displayed when they first met at the 2010 50K Championships in Galway, Ireland, where Donovan was the race director 名词搭配原样复现
analysis.辨邻: K K段焦点是妹妹对其性格的评价，跟陈述句要的「赛事总监的冒险气质打动了Wardian」完全不在一条线上。 Once he decides to do something, he just works at it until he does it

statements.en: Once Wardian sets his mind on something, he is determined to make it happen.
statements.zh: 一旦 Wardian 下定决心做某件事,他就决心将其实现

analysis.锚点: 一旦下决心做某事，就一定让它成真
analysis.定位: K 段 Once he decides to do something, he just works at it until he does it, Michael's younger sister, Mariele, said. Once he decides to do it, it's usually something that's going to happen. 「一旦他决定做某件事，他就会一直坚持到做成为止。」Michael的妹妹Mariele说，「一旦他决定要做，那件事通常就会成真。」
analysis.改写: Once Wardian sets his mind on something↔Once he decides to do something 习语同义替换 he is determined to make it happen↔he just works at it until he does it 决心+持续动作=必达结果
analysis.辨邻: L L段焦点是if you're not seeking things out that are challenging and difficult for you, then you're not growing——是成长哲学，与陈述句要的「下定决心就一定做成」是不同命题。 I want to always keep doing things that are exciting, adventurous, different and most importantly, probably things I'm not the best at E E段强调diverse and unique challenges与what my body can accept，是挑战类型与身体测试，并未提出「决心即必达」。 I'm definitely interested in seeing what I can handle and what my body can accept. That drives me

statements.en: One top American marathoner quit his running career because of his physical condition.
statements.zh: 一位美国顶级马拉松运动员因身体状况放弃了跑步生涯

analysis.锚点: 某位美国顶尖马拉松选手因身体状况退出跑步生涯
analysis.定位: H 段 Despite his proven track record, Hall said he has no time goals and that he still suffers from the same fatigue issues that forced him to leave the professional ranks in 2015. 尽管成绩斐然，Hall表示自己不设时间目标，并且仍在承受当年迫使他在2015年退出职业赛场的那种疲劳问题。
analysis.改写: One top American marathoner↔Ryan Hall, America's fastest marathon runner 形容词同义集合：top等于fastest quit his running career↔forced him to leave the professional ranks in 2015 被动结果与主动动作互换 because of his physical condition↔fatigue issues 具体症状被概括为身体状况
analysis.辨邻: I I段的焦点是「完赛即回报」与「借赛公益」的不同动机，没有任何「美国顶尖马拉松选手退役」的命题。 simply finishing will be its own reward

statements.en: To many of the week-long marathon participants, completing the race will be a success in itself.
statements.zh: 对于许多参加为期一周马拉松的选手来说,完成比赛本身就是一种成功

analysis.锚点: 对许多周赛参与者而言，完赛本身就是成功
analysis.定位: I 段 To others on the trip, simply finishing will be its own reward. 对这趟旅程里的其他人来说，仅仅完赛本身就是一种回报。
analysis.改写: To many of the week-long marathon participants↔To others on the trip 范围限定的同义替换 completing the race will be a success in itself↔simply finishing will be its own reward 完赛即回报=完赛即成功
analysis.辨邻: E 陈述句的主体是「许多周赛参与者」（非Wardian一人）；E段只讲Wardian自己。同时E段从未把「完赛」等同于「成功」，命题维度也不同。 I'm definitely interested in seeing what I can handle and what my body can accept. That drives me G G段焦点在getting comfortable being uncomfortable——讲完赛过程中要承受不适，而非「完赛本身就是成功」。 The key to a race like this is getting comfortable being uncomfortable

statements.en: For Wardian, the marathon in the Arctic was more about how to triumph over the extreme cold.
statements.zh: 对 Wardian 来说,北极的马拉松更多的是关于如何战胜极度寒冷

analysis.锚点: 北极那场马拉松对Wardian来说重点在战胜极寒
analysis.定位: C 段 The race for Wardian, however, was less about the result than overcoming his aversion to the cold. 然而对Wardian来说，这场比赛重点不在成绩，而在战胜自己对寒冷的厌恶。
analysis.改写: was more about how to triumph over the extreme cold↔was less about the result than overcoming his aversion to the cold 比较结构等值替换+动词同义 the marathon in the Arctic↔The race 代词性回指被还原为具体赛事
analysis.辨邻: A A段是开篇白描+科普机理，未对「赛事的意义」做评价；陈述句要的「赛事意义=战胜冷」恰恰只在C段被显式提出。 Too much effort and he'd begin to sweat, which, he was told, would only increase the risk of hypothermia B B段焦点在外部环境（温度、风寒、北极熊），不涉Wardian的赛事意义；陈述句的how to triumph over the extreme cold需要主体（Wardian）和对抗动作，B段没有。 At the 2014 North Pole Marathon, the temperature dipped to minus-22 degrees F

statements.en: To participate in the seven-day marathon series, Wardian had to raise a lot of money and have his wife's support.
statements.zh: 为了参加为期七天的马拉松系列赛,Wardian 必须筹集大量资金并获得妻子的支持

analysis.锚点: 为参赛Wardian需要筹大笔钱并征得妻子支持
analysis.定位: G 段 Wardian started saving for the trip in 2014, connecting with sponsors and getting approval from his wife, Jennifer, before committing. Wardian从2014年起为这趟旅程攒钱、联系赞助商，并在正式报名前征得了妻子Jennifer的同意。
analysis.改写: had to raise a lot of money↔started saving for the trip in 2014, connecting with sponsors 具体动作被概括为抽象动作 have his wife's support↔getting approval from his wife, Jennifer approval等于support的同义概括
analysis.辨邻: D D段焦点在「他将参赛+32位同行者」的事实，没有raise a lot of money/wife's support等备赛准备信息。 He will line up Monday in Antarctica for the first leg of the World Marathon Challenge

reading1.title: 2022年12月·第1套 英语六级阅读理解（四选一） 第 1 篇 · 46–50 题答案与解析

passages.en: Many people associate their self-worth with their work. The more successful their career, the better they feel about themselves. Work-related self-esteem is therefore a worthy ideal to pursue with vigor, right? Well, not always. According to recent research, in which psychologists interviewed 370 full-time workers over a period of three weeks, the reality is a little more complicated. And it involves negative as well as positive consequences.
passages.zh: 许多人把自我价值与工作联系在一起。事业越成功，他们对自己的感觉就越好。因此，努力追求与工作相关的自尊，应当是一个值得追求的理想，对吧？嗯，也不总是如此。根据近期的一项研究，心理学家在三周内采访了370名全职工作人员，现实情况要复杂一些，而且其中既有消极后果，也有积极后果。

passages.en: It's natural to be drawn towards pleasure and to step away from pain. In the workplace, if that pleasure comes from a triumph which swells our self-respect, people will try to repeat the accomplishment. But repeating that accomplishment is often not realistic, which can lead to severe negative emotional consequences when it doesn't reoccur. This form of motivation is widely regarded as a negative type of motivation. It can hinder other more positive motivation types, such as completing a task purely because it's fulfilling or enjoyable.
passages.zh: 人们自然会被快乐吸引，并会避开痛苦。在工作场所，如果这种快乐来自一次令我们的自尊膨胀的胜利，人们就会试图重复这一成就。但重复这一成就往往并不现实，而当它未能再次出现时，便可能导致严重的负面情绪后果。这种形式的动机被普遍视为一种消极动机。它可能妨碍其他更积极的动机类型，例如仅仅因为完成一项任务会带来满足感或乐趣而去完成它。

passages.en: What consumes the employee instead is a pressing need to feel mighty and sure of themselves. They then take on only tasks and objectives which serve that ego-driven need. As a result, to avoid feelings of shame and worthlessness associated with failure, they extend themselves to such a degree that there's a subsequent adverse effect on their well-being. This internal pressure to succeed at all costs demands a lot of effort. It depletes their energy, culminating in disproportionate levels of damaging sentiment.
passages.zh: 真正消耗员工的，是一种迫切想要感到强大并对自己充满信心的需要。于是，他们只承担那些能够满足这种受自我意识驱动的需要的任务和目标。结果，为了避免失败所带来的羞耻感和无价值感，他们过度透支自己，以至于随后对自身福祉产生不利影响。这种不惜一切代价取得成功的内在压力要求付出大量努力。它耗尽了他们的精力，最终导致有害情绪达到不成比例的程度。

passages.en: Those negative emotions mount into heightened anxiety, impacting their ability to make the most of their personal life. Their desire to avoid feeling inferior ends up making them feel inferior when it comes to their diminished capacity for friendship and leisure. They end up dissatisfied both at work and outside of it.
passages.zh: 这些负面情绪不断累积，演变为更强烈的焦虑，影响他们充分利用个人生活的能力。他们想要避免感到低人一等，结果却因为自己交友和休闲能力的减弱而感到低人一等。最终，他们在工作内外都感到不满。

passages.en: But thankfully, for those people compelled almost entirely by this specific form of motivation, the news isn't all bad, or bad at all. The study also discovered several positive outcomes that can actually outweigh the harmful ones. Though these types of employees are motivated by the desire to avoid negative consequences, they are also motivated by the excitement of pursuing emotional rewards. This excitement makes pursuing goals enjoyable and stimulates pleasure and pride that would result from success. An effect of the positive motivation is that it neutralizes the existence of negative motivation.
passages.zh: 但值得庆幸的是，对于那些几乎完全受这种特定形式的动机驱使的人来说，情况并非全然糟糕，甚至根本算不上糟糕。研究还发现了几项积极结果，而这些结果实际上可以超过有害结果。尽管这类员工受到避免负面后果的愿望驱动，但他们同样受到追求情感回报所带来的兴奋感驱动。这种兴奋感使追求目标变得愉快，并激发成功后将产生的快乐和自豪感。积极动机所产生的一个影响是，它抵消了消极动机的存在。

passages.en: Sure, it affects people's personal lives to what could be deemed an unhealthy extent, because leisure activities are often seen as a part of life that must be sacrificed to manage work and family demands. However, the way people feel about their work has less to do with whether they're motivated by the preservation of self-esteem but more with the fact that they're simply motivated.
passages.zh: 当然，这确实在某种可能被视为不健康的程度上影响了人们的个人生活，因为为了应对工作和家庭的要求，休闲活动常常被视为生活中必须牺牲的一部分。然而，人们对工作的感受，与其说更多取决于他们是否受到维护自尊的驱动，不如说更多取决于他们确实受到了激励。

questions.stem: What does the author say about the pursuit of work-related self-esteem?
questions.stem_zh: 作者对追求与工作相关的自尊有何看法?

options.text: It may result in negative motivation.
options.zh: 这可能导致负面动机。

options.text: It contributes to one's accomplishments.
options.zh: 这有助于个人成就。

options.text: It can increase one's vigor as one keeps trying.
options.zh: 随着不断尝试,这能增强个人活力。

options.text: It costs too much emotionally and psychologically.
options.zh: 这在情感和心理上代价太高。

questions.判型: What does the author say about the pursuit of work-related self-esteem 直接问作者对某话题的陈述，没有 infer/imply，需要回到原文找到该话题的明确表态句。
questions.拆句: 题干主干 What does the author say about... 是 wh- 疑问句，about 后接介宾 the pursuit of work-related self-esteem，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
questions.定位: P1 Work-related self-esteem is therefore a worthy ideal to pursue with vigor, right? Well, not always. According to recent research, in which psychologists interviewed 370 full-time workers over a period of three weeks, the reality is a little more complicated. And it involves negative as well as positive consequences. 于是工作型自尊就是一个值得全力追求的理想，对吗？嗯，并非总是如此。根据一项让心理学家在三周内访谈 370 名全职员工的近期研究，现实要更复杂一些。它既牵涉正面后果，也牵涉负面后果。

locate.en: Work-related self-esteem is therefore a worthy ideal to pursue with vigor, right? Well, not always. According to recent research, in which psychologists interviewed 370 full-time workers over a period of three weeks, the reality is a little more complicated. And it involves negative as well as positive consequences.
locate.zh: 于是工作型自尊就是一个值得全力追求的理想，对吗？嗯，并非总是如此。根据一项让心理学家在三周内访谈 370 名全职员工的近期研究，现实要更复杂一些。它既牵涉正面后果，也牵涉负面后果。

option_analysis.note: 预判的负面后果在 negative motivation 中被精确收口为研究真正定义的负面后果类型——动机层面的负面，故锁定 A。

pairs.orig: involves negative as well as positive consequences
pairs.opt: It may result in negative motivation

option_analysis.note: It contributes to one's accomplishments 把 a worthy ideal to pursue with vigor 当成作者真实观点，但作者立刻用 not always 否定了这种乐观说法。
It can increase one's vigor as one keeps trying 把原文中描述追求方式的 with vigor 改造成追求会增加 vigor，混淆 vigor 作方式状语与作宾语的角色。
It costs too much emotionally and psychologically 给出 too much 的程度判断，但首段仅说 involves negative as well as positive consequences，并未将代价定性为过高。

questions.stem: What do employees tend to do in pursuing work-related self-esteem?
questions.stem_zh: 员工在追求与工作相关的自尊时往往会做什么?

options.text: Take on tasks well beyond their actual capabilities.
options.zh: 承担远超自身实际能力的任务。

options.text: Strive to succeed at the expense of their well-being.
options.zh: 以牺牲自身幸福为代价努力获得成功。

options.text: Resort to all means regardless of the consequences.
options.zh: 不顾后果诉诸一切手段。

options.text: Exaggerate their sense of shame and worthlessness.
options.zh: 夸大自己的羞耻感和无价值感。

questions.判型: What do employees tend to do 是对客观行为的提问，不要求推断，回原文找直接描述行为的句子即可。
questions.拆句: 题干为 wh- 疑问句，主干 What do employees tend to do，in pursuing work-related self-esteem 是介词短语作伴随状语，限定行为发生的语境，无难句。
questions.定位: P3 As a result, to avoid feelings of shame and worthlessness associated with failure, they extend themselves to such a degree that there's a subsequent adverse effect on their well-being. 结果，为了躲开与失败相连的羞耻感和无价值感，他们把自己拉伸到这种程度，以至于随之而来的是对其身心健康的不利影响。

locate.en: As a result, to avoid feelings of shame and worthlessness associated with failure, they extend themselves to such a degree that there's a subsequent adverse effect on their well-being.
locate.zh: 结果，为了躲开与失败相连的羞耻感和无价值感，他们把自己拉伸到这种程度，以至于随之而来的是对其身心健康的不利影响。

option_analysis.note: Take on tasks well beyond their actual capabilities 把 to such a degree that there's a subsequent adverse effect on their well-being 改写为超出实际能力，但原文只说付出过度，没说任务超出能力。
预判中的拼命与损害自身两成分被 Strive to succeed 和 at the expense of their well-being 一一收拢，故锁定 B。

pairs.orig: they extend themselves to such a degree that there's a subsequent adverse effect on their well-being
pairs.opt: Strive to succeed at the expense of their well-being

option_analysis.note: Resort to all means regardless of the consequences 说他们不顾后果，但原文 to avoid feelings of shame and worthlessness associated with failure 恰恰说他们极其在意后果。
Exaggerate their sense of shame and worthlessness 把 to avoid feelings of shame and worthlessness 改成夸大羞耻感，正话反说。

questions.stem: What do we learn about people over-concerned with work-related self-esteem?
questions.stem_zh: 关于过度关注与工作相关的自尊的人,我们了解到什么?

options.text: They may often feel inferior to their colleagues.
options.zh: 他们可能经常觉得不如同事。

options.text: They cannot enjoy their personal life to the full.
options.zh: 他们无法充分享受个人生活。

options.text: They are never satisfied with their achievements.
options.zh: 他们对自己的成就从不满足。

options.text: They have their own view of friendship and leisure.
options.zh: 他们对友谊和休闲有自己的看法。

questions.判型: What do we learn about people over-concerned with work-related self-esteem 询问对某类人群的认识，要求回原文找作者对这类人的直接论断。
questions.拆句: 题干主干 What do we learn about people，过去分词短语 over-concerned with work-related self-esteem 作 people 的后置定语，限定具体人群，结构清晰。
questions.定位: P4 Those negative emotions mount into heightened anxiety, impacting their ability to make the most of their personal life. Their desire to avoid feeling inferior ends up making them feel inferior when it comes to their diminished capacity for friendship and leisure. 那些负面情绪累积成加剧的焦虑，影响他们充分享受个人生活的能力。他们想要避免自卑的渴望最终反而让他们在自己对友谊与闲暇的削弱能力面前感到自卑。

locate.en: Those negative emotions mount into heightened anxiety, impacting their ability to make the most of their personal life. Their desire to avoid feeling inferior ends up making them feel inferior when it comes to their diminished capacity for friendship and leisure.
locate.zh: 那些负面情绪累积成加剧的焦虑，影响他们充分享受个人生活的能力。他们想要避免自卑的渴望最终反而让他们在自己对友谊与闲暇的削弱能力面前感到自卑。

option_analysis.note: They may often feel inferior to their colleagues 把原文 feel inferior 的对照对象改成 colleagues，但原文比较对象是 diminished capacity for friendship and leisure，与同事无关。
预判中的个人生活质量被削弱被 cannot enjoy their personal life to the full 完整收拢，故锁定 B。

pairs.orig: impacting their ability to make the most of their personal life
pairs.opt: They cannot enjoy their personal life to the full

option_analysis.note: They are never satisfied with their achievements 用 never 加 with their achievements 描述成就维度的不满，但原文说的是 dissatisfied both at work and outside of it，且未升级到 never 的极端否定。
They have their own view of friendship and leisure 借 friendship and leisure 词面做诱饵，但原文只说他们对友谊与闲暇的能力削弱，从未说他们持独到看法。

questions.stem: What is the good news we learn from the recent research?
questions.stem_zh: 我们从最近的研究中了解到的好消息是什么?

options.text: The pursuit of goals may turn out to be enjoyable and pleasant.
options.zh: 追求目标可能会变得令人愉快和快乐。

options.text: The emotional rewards from goal pursuit are worth the pains taken.
options.zh: 追求目标带来的情感回报值得付出的辛苦。

options.text: The negative consequences of goal pursuit can mostly be avoided.
options.zh: 追求目标的负面后果大多可以避免。

options.text: The goal of swelling self-esteem can be achieved if one keeps trying.
options.zh: 如果不断尝试,提升自尊的目标可以实现。

questions.判型: What is the good news we learn from the recent research 询问原文里明示的正面发现，属客观转述，不需推断。
questions.拆句: 题干主干 What is the good news，we learn from the recent research 是省略关系代词的定语从句修饰 news，平铺直叙，无陷阱。
questions.定位: P5 Though these types of employees are motivated by the desire to avoid negative consequences, they are also motivated by the excitement of pursuing emotional rewards. This excitement makes pursuing goals enjoyable and stimulates pleasure and pride that would result from success. 尽管这些员工受到躲避负面后果的渴望驱使，他们同时也受到追求情感奖赏所带来的兴奋的驱使。这种兴奋让追求目标变得令人享受，并激发出本会因成功而产生的愉悦与自豪。

locate.en: Though these types of employees are motivated by the desire to avoid negative consequences, they are also motivated by the excitement of pursuing emotional rewards. This excitement makes pursuing goals enjoyable and stimulates pleasure and pride that would result from success.
locate.zh: 尽管这些员工受到躲避负面后果的渴望驱使，他们同时也受到追求情感奖赏所带来的兴奋的驱使。这种兴奋让追求目标变得令人享受，并激发出本会因成功而产生的愉悦与自豪。

option_analysis.note: 预判中的追求带来享受被 enjoyable and pleasant 完整收拢，故锁定 A。

pairs.orig: This excitement makes pursuing goals enjoyable and stimulates pleasure and pride
pairs.opt: The pursuit of goals may turn out to be enjoyable and pleasant

option_analysis.note: The emotional rewards from goal pursuit are worth the pains taken 引入代价对价值的权衡关系，但原文 An effect of the positive motivation is that it neutralizes the existence of negative motivation 只说正面动机中和负面动机，未做代价值得的判断。
The negative consequences of goal pursuit can mostly be avoided 把 neutralizes the existence of negative motivation 升级为多数可避免，但 neutralize 是抵消、不是避免，且原文未说大多数。
The goal of swelling self-esteem can be achieved if one keeps trying 与 repeating that accomplishment is often not realistic 直接冲突；原文明说重复成就并不现实。

questions.stem: What can we infer from the last paragraph?
questions.stem_zh: 我们可以从最后一段推断出什么?

options.text: Workers have to make sacrifices to preserve self-esteem.
options.zh: 员工必须做出牺牲以维护自尊。

options.text: Self-esteem swells when workers are strongly motivated.
options.zh: 当员工受到强烈激励时,自尊会提升。

options.text: Pursuit of goals affects people's personal lives to an unhealthy extent.
options.zh: 追求目标在不健康的程度上影响了人们的个人生活。

options.text: People feel positive about their work as long as they are motivated.
options.zh: 只要人们受到激励,他们就会对自己的工作感到积极。

questions.判型: What can we infer from the last paragraph 明示 infer，定位段已锁尾段，要求基于尾段明示信息做一步推断。
questions.拆句: 题干主干 What can we infer，from the last paragraph 是介词短语作状语指出推断的依据来源，结构简单。
questions.定位: P6 However, the way people feel about their work has less to do with whether they're motivated by the preservation of self-esteem but more with the fact that they're simply motivated. 然而，人们对工作的感受真正取决于的，与其说是他们是否被维护自尊的渴望所驱动，不如说是他们到底有没有被驱动这件事本身。

locate.en: However, the way people feel about their work has less to do with whether they're motivated by the preservation of self-esteem but more with the fact that they're simply motivated.
locate.zh: 然而，人们对工作的感受真正取决于的，与其说是他们是否被维护自尊的渴望所驱动，不如说是他们到底有没有被驱动这件事本身。

option_analysis.note: Workers have to make sacrifices to preserve self-esteem 把 leisure activities are often seen as a part of life that must be sacrificed to manage work and family demands 中牺牲闲暇的目的改成 preserve self-esteem，目的错位。
Self-esteem swells when workers are strongly motivated 把因果说成动机强则自尊膨胀，但原文 has less to do with whether they're motivated by the preservation of self-esteem 反而弱化了自尊在因果链里的地位。
Pursuit of goals affects people's personal lives to an unhealthy extent 把 Sure, it affects people's personal lives to what could be deemed an unhealthy extent 这一让步分句当作尾段主结论，但 However 之后才是作者真正立场。
预判中的有动机即正向感受被 as long as they are motivated 完整收拢，且 positive 与文章正向 good news 区段的态度一致，故锁定 D。

pairs.orig: the way people feel about their work has less to do with whether they're motivated by the preservation of self-esteem but more with the fact that they're simply motivated
pairs.opt: People feel positive about their work as long as they are motivated

reading2.title: 2022年12月·第1套 英语六级阅读理解（四选一） 第 2 篇 · 51–55 题答案与解析

passages.en: Degradation of the world's natural resources by humans is rapidly outpacing the planet's ability to absorb the damage, a recent UN environmental study has found. The study concludes that without radical action the level of prosperity that millions of people in the developed world count on will be impossible to maintain or extend to poorer countries.
passages.zh: 联合国最近的一项环境研究发现，人类对世界自然资源的破坏正迅速超过地球吸收这种损害的能力。该研究得出结论：如果不采取彻底的行动，发达国家数百万人所依赖的繁荣水平将无法维持，也不可能推广到较贫困的国家。

passages.en: Water scarcity is the curse of some of the poorest regions on Earth, leaving developing countries increasingly unable to feed themselves, and causing hardship for millions of people. There appears little prospect of this desperate situation being remedied without radical action being taken. Water resources are under increasing threat from population growth, climate change, rapid urbanization, rising levels of consumption, and the degradation of lands that previously provided a natural replenishment(补充) of water resources.
passages.zh: 水资源短缺是地球上一些最贫困地区的祸根，使发展中国家越来越无力养活自己，并给数百万人带来困苦。如果不采取彻底的行动，这种绝望的状况似乎很难得到改善。人口增长、气候变化、快速城市化、消费水平上升，以及原本能够自然补充水资源的土地遭到退化，都使水资源面临日益严重的威胁。

passages.en: The rate of damage to the natural environment was found to increase globally, despite concerted efforts to persuade government to take measures to improve the condition. "If current trends continue, and the world fails to improve patterns of production and consumption, then the state of the world's environment will continue to decline," warned UN executive director Achim Steiner.
passages.zh: 研究发现，尽管人们共同努力劝说政府采取措施改善环境状况，但自然环境遭受破坏的速度在全球范围内仍在加快。联合国执行主任阿希姆·施泰纳警告说：“如果当前趋势持续下去，而世界未能改善生产和消费模式，那么世界环境状况将继续恶化。”

passages.en: He said the tools for improving the environment for millions of people existed in developed countries, but were in danger of not being used.
passages.zh: 他说，发达国家已经拥有改善数百万人民生活环境的手段，但这些手段有可能得不到使用。

passages.en: The study found that basic measures to tackle some of the key causes of environmental damage were still not being taken. These included measures to reduce air pollution; to control the damage to marine ecosystems, which can have a huge effect on fish stocks on which hundreds of millions of people depend; and to curb the degradation of land where modern agricultural methods were pursued without regard to the longer-term consequences.
passages.zh: 研究发现，人们仍未采取解决环境破坏一些主要原因的基本措施。其中包括减少空气污染的措施；控制对海洋生态系统破坏的措施，因为这种破坏会对数亿人赖以生存的鱼类资源产生巨大影响；以及遏制土地退化的措施，因为现代农业方法的推行没有顾及长期后果。

passages.en: Despite the recent global agreement on cutting greenhouse gas emissions, global carbon output continues to rise. This will put a long-term strain on the ability of developing economies to feed their own people. Climate change is aggravated by the emissions of greenhouse gases from chemical and natural fertilisers used in agriculture which increased by more than a quarter between 2000 and 2010. Other problem areas identified in the report included glaciers, which provide vital water resources for millions of people, but which are shrinking as the climate warms.
passages.zh: 尽管最近全球就削减温室气体排放达成了协议，但全球碳排放量仍在持续上升。这将长期削弱发展中经济体养活本国人民的能力。农业中使用的化学肥料和天然肥料所排放的温室气体使气候变化进一步加剧，而这些排放量在2000年至2010年间增加了四分之一以上。报告确定的其他问题领域还包括冰川，它们为数百万人提供至关重要的水资源，但随着气候变暖正在不断缩小。

passages.en: In rich countries, these problems have built up over decades and centuries while economic growth was pursued at the expense of the environment. Subsequent efforts to remedy the environment have met with partial success. But in developing countries, the path of future development has more potential to change, which has encouraged international institutions to devise more sustainable growth pathways that are supposed both to alleviate poverty and preserve the environment.
passages.zh: 在富裕国家，这些问题是在数十年乃至数百年的经济增长过程中逐渐积累起来的，而经济增长是以牺牲环境为代价的。随后为改善环境所作的努力取得了部分成效。但在发展中国家，未来的发展道路更有可能发生改变，这促使国际机构制定更加可持续的增长路径，旨在既减轻贫困，又保护环境。

questions.stem: What is the major finding of the UN environmental study?
questions.stem_zh: 联合国环境研究的主要发现是什么?

options.text: Human activity has rendered Mother Earth almost uninhabitable.
options.zh: 人类活动已使地球母亲几乎不适宜居住。

options.text: Humans are doing more damage to the earth than it can cope with.
options.zh: 人类对地球造成的破坏超过了地球的承受能力。

options.text: Environmental problems have considerably weakened human prosperity.
options.zh: 环境问题已大大削弱了人类的繁荣。

options.text: Environmental damage is more serious in developed countries these days.
options.zh: 如今发达国家的环境破坏更为严重。

questions.判型: 题干 What is the major finding of the UN environmental study? 问的是研究的"主要发现"，对应全文的中心结论，而非局部细节。
questions.拆句: What is the major finding of the UN environmental study? 是典型 wh-疑问句，主干 What is the major finding，of 短语修饰 finding，无从句、无否定，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。

option_analysis.note: Mother Earth almost uninhabitable 说地球"几乎不宜居住"，原文只说破坏速度超过吸收能力，并未提到地球已濒临不宜居住的程度。
预判"破坏速度超过地球承受力"在 Humans are doing more damage to the earth than it can cope with 中以 more...than it can cope with 完整复现，是定位句的标准同义替换。

pairs.orig: Degradation of the world's natural resources by humans is rapidly outpacing the planet's ability to absorb the damage
pairs.opt: Humans are doing more damage to the earth than it can cope with

option_analysis.note: 原文意思是"破坏超过吸收能力会使富国当前繁荣不可维持"——是"环境破坏会损害繁荣"的预言；Environmental problems have considerably weakened human prosperity 改成"环境问题已经显著削弱了人类繁荣"，把未来的预警偷换成已发生的事实。
Environmental damage is more serious in developed countries these days 断言发达国家环境破坏更严重，原文从未做"发达国家 vs 发展中国家谁更严重"的横向比较，是无中生有的比较。

questions.stem: What is said about water scarcity in some of the poorest regions?
questions.stem_zh: 关于一些最贫困地区的水资源短缺问题,文中说了什么?

options.text: It is getting so serious that there is little hope of solution.
options.zh: 问题变得如此严重以至于几乎没有解决的希望。

options.text: It largely accounts for their slow economic development.
options.zh: 这在很大程度上是这些地区经济发展缓慢的原因。

options.text: It can hardly be relieved if no drastic measures are taken.
options.zh: 如果不采取严厉措施,水资源短缺问题很难得到缓解。

options.text: It is primarily caused by the acceleration of climate change.
options.zh: 水资源短缺问题主要是由气候变化加速造成的。

questions.判型: 题干 What is said about water scarcity in some of the poorest regions? 形式 "What is said about X"，问的是文中对 X 的具体陈述，是典型细节题。
questions.拆句: What is said about water scarcity in some of the poorest regions? 被动语态，主干 What is said，about 介词短语带出讨论对象，in 短语限定范围；结构清楚、无陷阱。
questions.定位: P2 There appears little prospect of this desperate situation being remedied without radical action being taken. 如果不采取激进行动，这种绝望的状况几乎没有得到改善的前景。

locate.en: There appears little prospect of this desperate situation being remedied without radical action being taken.
locate.zh: 如果不采取激进行动，这种绝望的状况几乎没有得到改善的前景。

option_analysis.note: 原文是"不激进行动则无望"——前提是"如果不采取"，there is little hope of solution 把条件去掉、直接断言"几乎无解"，把有条件的判断推为无条件结论，过度推断。
原文只说水资源短缺让发展中国家 increasingly unable to feed themselves, and causing hardship for millions of people，关心的是粮食与民生；It largely accounts for their slow economic development 转到"经济发展缓慢"上，原文未做此因果归因。
预判"无激进行动→几乎无望解决"在 It can hardly be relieved if no drastic measures are taken 中以 hardly + if no...are taken 完整复刻，是定位句的标准同义重写。

pairs.orig: There appears little prospect of this desperate situation being remedied without radical action being taken
pairs.opt: It can hardly be relieved if no drastic measures are taken

option_analysis.note: 原文罗列了 population growth, climate change, rapid urbanization, rising levels of consumption, and the degradation of lands 五个并列威胁因素；It is primarily caused by the acceleration of climate change 单挑"气候加剧"为主因，原文从未做此排序。

questions.stem: What does Achim Steiner say about the environmental condition?
questions.stem_zh: Achim Steiner对环境状况有何看法?

options.text: It will deteriorate worldwide.
options.zh: 环境状况将在全球范围内恶化。

options.text: It is attracting global attention.
options.zh: 环境状况正在引起全球关注。

options.text: It is being slowly remedied globally.
options.zh: 环境状况正在全球范围内缓慢改善。

options.text: It will shrink the world's population.
options.zh: 环境状况将导致世界人口减少。

questions.判型: 题干 What does Achim Steiner say about the environmental condition? 问具体人物对具体话题的具体陈述，属于事实细节，不是推断或主旨。
questions.拆句: What does Achim Steiner say about the environmental condition? 主动语态特殊疑问句，主干 What does Achim Steiner say，about 短语带出陈述对象，无从句无否定，结构透明。
questions.定位: P3 If current trends continue, and the world fails to improve patterns of production and consumption, then the state of the world's environment will continue to decline. 如果当前趋势继续下去，世界又无法改善生产与消费模式，那么全球环境状况将持续恶化。

locate.en: If current trends continue, and the world fails to improve patterns of production and consumption, then the state of the world's environment will continue to decline.
locate.zh: 如果当前趋势继续下去，世界又无法改善生产与消费模式，那么全球环境状况将持续恶化。

option_analysis.note: 预判"环境将持续恶化"在 It will deteriorate worldwide 中以 will deteriorate 保留 will 未来时态，worldwide 保留全球范围，整句结构紧贴定位句。

pairs.orig: the state of the world's environment will continue to decline

option_analysis.note: It is attracting global attention 说环境正吸引全球关注，原文 Steiner 引语只谈"将继续恶化"，未提全球对它的关注度。
It is being slowly remedied globally 说环境正在被缓慢修复，与原文 the rate of damage to the natural environment was found to increase globally 及 Steiner 引语"将继续恶化"完全相反。
It will shrink the world's population 说环境状况会缩减世界人口，原文 Steiner 引语只字未提人口收缩。

questions.stem: What is the dilemma developing countries face?
questions.stem_zh: 发展中国家面临什么困境?

options.text: They cannot modernise farming without causing land degradation.
options.zh: 这些国家无法在不造成土地退化的情况下实现农业现代化。

options.text: They cannot promote industrialisation without polluting waterways.
options.zh: 这些国家无法在不污染水道的情况下推进工业化。

options.text: They cannot boost crop yields without causing greenhouse gas emissions.
options.zh: 这些国家无法在不造成温室气体排放的情况下提高农作物产量。

options.text: They cannot catch up with rich countries without sacrificing the environment.
options.zh: 这些国家无法在不牺牲环境的情况下赶上富裕国家。

questions.判型: 题干 What is the dilemma developing countries face? 问的是文中明确描述的具体两难，是文中实有陈述的细节，不是推理。
questions.拆句: What is the dilemma developing countries face? 主干 What is the dilemma，后接省略关系代词的定语从句 (which/that) developing countries face 修饰 dilemma；基础薄弱考生易把 face 误解为名词"面孔"，须留意它在此是及物动词"面对"。
questions.定位: P6 This will put a long-term strain on the ability of developing economies to feed their own people. Climate change is aggravated by the emissions of greenhouse gases from chemical and natural fertilisers used in agriculture which increased by more than a quarter between 2000 and 2010. 这（碳排放上升）将长期压制发展中经济体养活本国人口的能力。气候变化又被农业中化肥（化学与天然）所排放的温室气体所加剧——这类排放在 2000 到 2010 年间增长了超过四分之一。

locate.en: This will put a long-term strain on the ability of developing economies to feed their own people. Climate change is aggravated by the emissions of greenhouse gases from chemical and natural fertilisers used in agriculture which increased by more than a quarter between 2000 and 2010.
locate.zh: 这（碳排放上升）将长期压制发展中经济体养活本国人口的能力。气候变化又被农业中化肥（化学与天然）所排放的温室气体所加剧——这类排放在 2000 到 2010 年间增长了超过四分之一。

option_analysis.note: cannot modernise farming without causing land degradation 是"现代化农业导致土地退化"，原文第 5 段才提 curb the degradation of land where modern agricultural methods were pursued，但与本题第 6 段的"养人 vs 温室气体"两难是两个不同话题。
cannot promote industrialisation without polluting waterways 说"工业化必然污染水道"，原文未谈发展中国家工业化的两难，也未谈水道污染。
预判"养人靠提产、提产致排放"在 They cannot boost crop yields without causing greenhouse gas emissions 中以 cannot...without... 双重否定形式把目的与代价绑成两难，与原文两面对应。

pairs.orig: This will put a long-term strain on the ability of developing economies to feed their own people
Climate change is aggravated by the emissions of greenhouse gases from chemical and natural fertilisers used in agriculture

option_analysis.note: cannot catch up with rich countries without sacrificing the environment 说"追赶富国必牺牲环境"，这是 P7 谈"富国曾以环境换增长"的引申、且原文 P7 的态度是发展中国家"有潜力改变路径"——选项把 P7 的论点反向化，又错放进本题两难。

questions.stem: What should developing countries do in their future development according to the passage?
questions.stem_zh: 根据文章,发展中国家在未来发展中应该怎么做?

options.text: They turn to developed countries for the assistance they need.
options.zh: 这些国家应向发达国家寻求所需的援助。

options.text: They remedy environmental damage by slowing economic growth.
options.zh: 这些国家应通过放缓经济增长来修复环境破坏。

options.text: They avoid damaging interference from international institutions.
options.zh: 这些国家应避免来自国际机构的破坏性干预。

options.text: They improve people's livelihood without harming the environment.
options.zh: 这些国家应在不损害环境的情况下改善人民生活。

questions.判型: 题干 What should developing countries do in their future development according to the passage? 明确要 according to the passage，问文中给出的具体建议，是细节题不是推断。
questions.拆句: What should developing countries do in their future development according to the passage? 情态动词疑问句，主干 What should developing countries do，in 短语限定时间范围，according to 短语指明答题依据；结构清晰无陷阱。
questions.定位: P7 But in developing countries, the path of future development has more potential to change, which has encouraged international institutions to devise more sustainable growth pathways that are supposed both to alleviate poverty and preserve the environment. 但在发展中国家，未来发展的路径有更大的可改变潜力，这促使国际机构设计了更可持续的发展路径——既要减贫，又要保护环境。

locate.en: But in developing countries, the path of future development has more potential to change, which has encouraged international institutions to devise more sustainable growth pathways that are supposed both to alleviate poverty and preserve the environment.
locate.zh: 但在发展中国家，未来发展的路径有更大的可改变潜力，这促使国际机构设计了更可持续的发展路径——既要减贫，又要保护环境。

option_analysis.note: turn to developed countries for the assistance they need 说"向发达国家求援"，原文 P7 只说国际机构"设计了可持续路径"，未提向发达国家求援。
remedy environmental damage by slowing economic growth 说"靠放缓经济增长来修补环境"，但原文 P7 提的 sustainable growth pathways 是"既减贫又护环境"——发展与环保并行，不是减速换环保。
avoid damaging interference from international institutions 说"避开国际机构的破坏性干预"，但原文 P7 has encouraged international institutions to devise more sustainable growth pathways 中国际机构是建设性角色——选项把它颠倒成"破坏性"。
预判"减贫与护环境兼顾"在 They improve people's livelihood without harming the environment 中以 improve...without harming 双动作并列承接 both...and 结构，是 P7 对策句的标准同义改写。

translation.title: 2022年12月·第1套英语六级汉译英（段落翻译） · 客观介绍青藏高原的概况与生态 参考译文与解析
translation.directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to translate a passage from Chinese into English. You should write your answer on Answer Sheet 2.
translation.source_zh: 青藏高原(the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau)位于中国西南部，面积约230万平方公里，平均海拔4000米以上，被称为"世界屋脊"。青藏高原自然资源丰富，风景秀丽，拥有多种珍稀野生动物。 青藏高原气温很低，形成了大面积高山冰川。这里是亚洲许多著名河流的源头，是中国和东南亚的主要淡水供应源。青藏高原对全球生态系统至关重要。 由于气候变化的影响，青藏高原的冰川正在加速融化。中国一直在努力保护青藏高原的生态系统，草地覆盖率不断增加，许多濒危物种得到更为有效的保护。
translation.reference_en:
Located in the southwest of China, the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, with an area of about 2.3 million square kilometers and an average altitude of over 4,000 meters, is known as "the Roof of the World". It is rich in natural resources, boasts beautiful scenery, and is home to various rare wild animals. Due to its low temperatures, the plateau has formed large areas of alpine glaciers. It is the source of many famous rivers in Asia and a major freshwater supply for China and Southeast Asia. It is vital to the global ecosystem. Due to climate change, the glaciers on the plateau are melting at an accelerating rate. China has been making efforts to protect the ecosystem of the plateau, with grassland coverage steadily increasing and many endangered species being more effectively protected.
【衔接】
第2句起改用 It 承接，避免反复整名第1句首次出现全名 the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau 后，第2句 青藏高原自然资源丰富 不再重复整名，改用代词 It 承接（It is rich in…）；第4句 这里 同样译 It。整篇靠 It 串联，既连贯又不啰嗦。
第6句因果转折处补 due to 显逻辑第5句说青藏高原「至关重要」，第6句 由于气候变化的影响，青藏高原的冰川正在加速融化 转入「正面临威胁」。句首 Due to climate change 既交代原因，也自然完成从「价值」到「危机」的语义过渡，无需另加转折词。
